description: This file defines a Kotlin interface 'NetworkMonitor' used as a utility to report app connectivity status through a reactive Flow of Boolean values.

classes.name: NetworkMonitor
classes.description: An interface representing a network connectivity status monitor, providing a reactive Flow<Boolean> to observe online/offline status.

methods.name: isOnline
methods.description: A read-only property returning a Flow<Boolean> indicating current online status, which emits updates as connectivity changes.
